lesson.title: Practice: New Chord: E + cowboy set complete
lesson.one_line_promise: Drill what New Chord: E + cowboy set complete taught — many ways, one goal.

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

easyC.name: C major (Lauren's 'easy C' — 2-finger reduction)
easyC.note: Reduced 2-finger C voicing for confidence-building. Spelling verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as C E G. 'Lauren's easy C' is a teaching label; arithmetic proves the fingering spells C major and is playable.

exercises.name: Chord-Perfect: E
exercises.purpose: Place E slowly, pick each string, fix any buzz/mute. Accuracy over speed.
exercises.coaching: Slow down. Make E, then pick each string one at a time. If one is muted or buzzing, fix that string before moving on.

exercises.name: One-Minute Changes: Em ↔ easyC
exercises.purpose: Count clean Em↔easyC changes in 60s. 30/min to advance, 60/min goal.
exercises.coaching: Metronome on. One minute: Em to easyC, back and forth, as many CLEAN changes as you can. Only confident, clean strums count. Hit 30 to advance, 60 is the goal.

exercises.coaching: Lift off the neck, make easyC in the air, drop it down all at once. Landing together beats placing finger by finger.

exercises.name: Tempo-Scaled Section Loop: Em ↔ easyC
exercises.purpose: Loop the hard bar at 25–125% tempo, then speed up.
exercises.coaching: Set the slider to ~50% and loop Em↔easyC until clean, then nudge it up. Only raise tempo when the change is smooth.

exercises.name: Wait-To-Play: target Em
exercises.purpose: Do not strum until the listener is confident it hears Em.
exercises.coaching: Stay silent until you hear Em clearly, then play. Discipline over speed.

exercises.name: Anchor / Pivot: Em → easyC
exercises.purpose: Find the shared finger and pivot around it through the change.
exercises.coaching: Keep the shared finger down; move only what must move.

exercises.name: Metronome ladder: Em ↔ easyC
exercises.purpose: Raise BPM only when the level was clean (≥45 changes/min).
exercises.coaching: Climb 60→140 one clean level at a time. Repeat a level if it was not clean.

exercises.name: Weak-Pair Review (K=3)
exercises.purpose: Drill the K weakest pairs the engine flagged from real measurement.
exercises.coaching: The engine picked these — they are your real weak spots, not a generic list.

exercises.name: Spider warm-up
exercises.purpose: Walk fingers up/down the fretboard to loosen the fretting hand.
exercises.coaching: One finger per fret, strict alternation. Keep it even.

exercises.name: Muted / percussive strum
exercises.purpose: Rhythm hand alone — no pitch. Lock steady muted hits.
exercises.coaching: Mute the strings with your fretting hand and strum rhythm only. Count the beats.

exercises.name: Count-out-loud
exercises.purpose: Lock tempo by counting 1-&-2-& before strumming.
exercises.coaching: Say the grid out loud: 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Stay on the beat.

practice_menu.note: Student picks any subset; app sequences warm-up -> accuracy -> retrieval -> speed -> weak-pair.

must_verify: Practice chord set == teaching chord set + cumulative (curriculum §5.1).
Every one-minute-changes exercise carries the exact chord_pair the 30/60 sensor counts.
No new chord fingering introduced (practice only rehearses taught chords).
